who you are.
It cares what you can do.

ACCA

I am a financial analyst, building a career in investment finance from the ground up, no shortcuts.

My background is in Commerce — Accounting, Economics, and Business Studies. I apply that foundation to real deliverables: financial models built from scratch in Excel, DCF valuations, business plans with full financial projections, and bookkeeping systems for small businesses.

I am simultaneously studying ACCA and preparing for CFA Level 1.
